remove_bg_note: Serving MUST match training. v1 was trained on full frames, so removal is off. A model trained with removal on ships a config with remove_bg=true, and src/predict_folder.py then applies src/remove_bg.py automatically. Never flip this by hand on a trained model.
calibrated_on: validation split only; test split used as a check
rationale: validation healthy photos score 0.26-0.39, so T_low=0.50 sits above the healthy band; T_high=0.90 marks strong confidence. The earlier infected-quantile recipe collapsed both thresholds to ~0.91 and reported hedged scores as no_visible_signs.
